definitions.explanation: A humble first-person plural pronoun used to refer to oneself and one's group, typically in business or formal settings when speaking to customers, superiors, or outsiders.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}{共|ども}にお{任|まか}せください。
{私|わたし}{共|ども}の{会社|かいしゃ}では、{品質|ひんしつ}を{大切|たいせつ}にしております。
examples.english: At our company, we value quality.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}{共|ども}の{不手際|ふてぎわ}でご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけし、{誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
examples.english: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by our error.

notes:
A humble ({謙譲語|けんじょうご}) first-person plural pronoun. The ども suffix is a humble pluralizer that lowers the speaker's status relative to the listener. Very common in business Japanese.

FORMS:
{私|わたし} (I) + {共|ども} (humble plural suffix). The suffix ども can also attach to other words, but {私|わたし}{共|ども} is by far the most common combination.

USAGE:
Used when representing one's company, organization, or family to outsiders. Appropriate in formal correspondence, customer service, and business meetings. Not used in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私|わたし}たち: neutral "we" — standard and appropriate in most situations
- {我々|われわれ}: "we" — formal and assertive, used in speeches and official statements
- {弊社|へいしゃ}: "our company" (humble) — specifically for one's own company, while {私|わたし}{共|ども} can refer to any in-group

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}の{店|みせ}: our shop (humble)
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}の{製品|せいひん}: our products (humble)
- {私|わたし}{共|ども}としましては: from our standpoint (humble)
